blazers.pulse: Portland won 124-114 in Milwaukee on Thursday to get to 10-5, with Dame dropping a season-high 33 in his return to Milwaukee. Scoot Henderson's season-high 27 off the bench has fans and the coaches feeling good about him after a rough start. The worry is Deni Avdija's sore left foot heading into tonight at the Garden.
storylines: Beat the Bucks 124-114; Lillard 33, Holiday 22, Henderson 27 off the bench
Assistant Micah Nori on Scoot: the team has "lost zero faith" in him
Avdija (left foot) missed the last two games and is questionable
Tonight at the Knicks (9-6), 4:30 PT; Morant and Sharpe still out

timbers.pulse: The playoffs start today: Portland, the No. 7 seed, opens a best-of-3 at No. 2 FC Dallas. Fans are riding a late surge under Marti Cifuentes, who took over midseason and closed with four straight wins and five unbeaten. Dallas won the season series, though, and has Golden Boot runner-up Petar Musa.
storylines: Game 1 today at Dallas, 1:00 PT on Apple TV
Game 2 at Providence Park Sat Nov 28; Game 3 (if needed) Dec 2 in Dallas
Kristoffer Velde led the team with 12 goals and 10 assists, and scored 4 in the last 3 games
Ties go straight to penalties, no extra time

f1.pulse: Kimi Antonelli was fastest in Las Vegas qualifying but drops to sixth with an engine penalty, handing Max Verstappen pole with George Russell alongside. Verstappen also escaped punishment after stewards looked at run-ins with Russell and Colapinto. Antonelli already clinched the title in Mexico City, so the real fight is for second.
storylines: Verstappen on pole; Russell, Norris, Hadjar next; Antonelli starts 6th after a 5-place engine penalty
Piastri takes a 10-place penalty and starts 17th
Stewards summoned Verstappen over incidents with Russell and Colapinto; no penalty
Title is Antonelli's; Verstappen (279) leads Russell (262) and Hamilton (261) for P2 after Sao Paulo
Mercedes already sealed the constructors' title

ducks.pulse: Oregon rolled Michigan State 45-7 in East Lansing on Friday night for a fourth straight win, now 8-3. Brandon Smith ran for a career-high 121 yards and two TDs filling in for the injured Dierre Hill. Playoff hopes are alive but need a win over Washington and some help.
storylines: Beat Michigan State 45-7; Brandon Smith 121 yards, 2 TDs
8-3 (6-2 Big Ten), No. 13 in the CFP rankings with work left to do
Next: vs. Washington at Autzen, Sat Nov 28, either 4:00 PT on FS1 or 4:30 PT on NBC (Big Ten picks after this weekend)

niners.pulse: At 8-1 with a three-game NFC West lead, fans are happy, but the 46-40 shootout win in Dallas left the defense under a microscope after it gave up 40 points and 439 yards. Sunday night in Mexico City against the 7-2 Vikings is being billed as a real NFC test.
storylines: Next: vs. Vikings in Mexico City, Sun Nov 22, 5:20 PT on NBC and Peacock
8-1 after a 46-40 shootout win at Dallas, with a three-game NFC West lead
Defense worries: 40 points allowed in Dallas, little pressure, Renardo Green and Deommodore Lenoir banged up
